Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance

Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1310
Claimant:
Christine Solomon
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
2-9-23
Claim opened for a parking lot collision in which the insured's vehicle was struck while stopped. The claimant reports
a concussion from the impact and is not represented by an attorney, so all contact is being handled directly with the
claimant.
2-15-23
Reviewed the driver's listing on the policy and confirmed the driver is a named insured, with coverage active at the
time of loss. Nothing in the file suggests the vehicle damage predates the coverage start.
5-3-23
Spoke with the claimant, who gave the same account of the collision as in the initial report. Police notes and two
independent witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle at the time, and the other driver's statement matches.
5-6-23
Photos from the scene and the repair estimate show damage consistent with the described impact, and the injury
pattern reported by the claimant fits the force of the crash. No prior injury to the same body area appears in the
records available so far.
5-12-23
Treatment has continued somewhat longer than is typical for a concussion of this kind. Requested updated medical
records and will review them once received. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known from prior claims or inspection
notes.
7-18-23
Reviewed the full file, including the account, scene photos, witness statements, and medical history. Everything is
consistent, and the claim is moving forward for evaluation of the injury and vehicle damage.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
